task: Compact AXI interface wrapper (3 m_axi + 1 AXI-Lite) around the accepted fused integer Selector pipeline

contract.score_q: local on-chip uint16_t buffer[G]; NOT a top-level port and never DDR
inputs: input_arena [G*320 + 8] 128-bit words: tokens | group means | query
contract.outputs: output_arena [ispc_fpga_layout(K).total_bytes/16] 128-bit words: tokens + 4 metadata segments at frozen offsets
contract.reuse: the two accepted translation units are #include'd into the wrapper; is_scorer_core<> and token_selector_core_packed are called directly; no second copy of the maths

wv.note: reused by SHA, never retrained; Wv scale is a positive common factor

critical_path.note: no timing violation -> the tool reports no violating critical path; the effective budget (target - uncertainty) is the limiting constraint

layout_authority.note: fixed arena values and the 5 segment offsets/sizes are produced live by the frozen contract

limitations: HLS evidence only: csynth_design plus host g++/ASan/UBSan and Vitis HLS C-simulation.  This is NOT RTL co-simulation, NOT place-and-route/routed timing, NOT a bitstream, NOT a board measurement and NOT a model end-to-end latency or task-accuracy result.

The per-configuration G80/K48, G260/K64 and G400/K96 cycle counts are FORMULA estimates built from the tool-reported per-loop unit costs; only the reported best/average/worst latency (compile-time trip-count bounds) is a tool number.
The transfer audit is a model with an explicit 1 GbE effective-bandwidth assumption and a sensitivity band; it is not a measured link throughput.
The compact envelope removes the intermediate score_q FPGA-DDR round trip and merges the input pointers into one arena; it does not remove the Jetson <-> FPGA round trip.
group_mean_q is still supplied inside the input arena; reconstructing it from tokens_q in the PL is not attempted here and the accepted group-mean quantisation contract is unchanged.
Wv is assumed to remain resident in FPGA-attached memory in the corrected resident mode; the cold mode number is reported for completeness.
No IP export, no cosim and no implementation/PnR were run; the AXI-Lite interface count is proven from the generated csynth report/XML only.
